description: This file defines an API class for marking a candidate's interview as failed within the recruitment module of OrangeHRM. It contains validation rules, API metadata, and the logic to specify the resulting workflow state when an interview fails.

classes.name: CandidateMarkingInterviewFailAPI
classes.description: API class to handle failing a candidate interview and updating workflow state accordingly.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating/interview fail operation, including validation for interview ID.

methods.name: getResultingState
methods.description: Returns the workflow state constant indicating the interview has failed.
